_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is a confirmed coil inside the Anxiety band with no visible breaker; OPEX can whip price without forcing a rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit forward HOLD/Anxiety; narrative supplies no phase call — split only on color, not on rung hold
next_move.confirmed_if: Post-OPEX fear holds 25-40, BTC range-bound, ETF flows and CVD still dead
next_move.invalidated_if: Trend day drives fear into low-20s with CVD pinned (panic break) or ETF/stablecoin demand restarts and fear lifts through mid-40s (relief break)
